steps.caption: Property Records
steps.narration: This is Property Records, a directory of US county assessor and property appraiser offices.

steps.caption: Over 3,000 offices
steps.narration: It lists more than three thousand offices, from NETR Online's public records directory.

steps.caption: Pick a state
steps.narration: Pick a state, and the list keeps only that state's offices.

steps.caption: Or pick a county or jurisdiction
steps.narration: A County / jurisdiction list appears next to it, or you can type the county's name.

steps.caption: Search by office, county or state
steps.narration: Type Sarasota, and the list comes down to that county's office.

steps.caption: The office and its link check
steps.narration: The card shows the office, its county, and when its link was last checked.

steps.caption: Open portal: the county's own site
steps.narration: Open portal takes you to the county's own records site. You look the property up there.

steps.caption: Call the office
steps.narration: Call dials the office's number, where the directory lists one.

steps.caption: Another county: Alachua
steps.narration: Now type Alachua, a county whose link the check couldn't confirm.

steps.caption: Not auto-verified, with its last check
steps.narration: Its card says not auto-verified, with the date of the last check, so you know to double-check it.

steps.caption: Find property records: a web search
steps.narration: Find property records runs a web search for the county's office, instead of guessing an address.

steps.caption: The offices' own sites hold the records
steps.narration: The offices' own sites hold ownership, values and tax records. ConstructHUB doesn't pull them in.

steps.caption: Included with Pro, Agency and Unlimited
steps.narration: Property Records is included with the Pro, Agency and Unlimited plans.

steps.caption: Menu: Property Records
steps.narration: You'll find Property Records in the menu, under Permits & Databases.

youtube.title: Property Records in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Property Records in ConstructHUB: a directory of US county assessor and property appraiser offices, filtered by state and county, with a checked link to each office's own records site and its phone number. You look the property up on the county's site.
